name: forecasting_write_sales_forecast
description:
Validate and write user/AI-adjusted sales forecast values directly to ClickHouse for downstream planning. Consequential (writes data).

Use cases:
- Persist manual forecast overrides for specific items and periods
- Persist AI-recommended adjustments with an explainable reason
- Store sales history (actuals) for actual-vs-forecast comparison

Safety:
- Always include company_id and an explicit item selector (inventory_id or sku+marketplace)
- Always include a reason and an author/source
- Prefer dry_run=true for validation before writing
- The full batch is rejected when any item cannot be resolved in the current ClickHouse catalog

Write behavior:
- Rows are inserted into etl.sales_forecast
- append and replace are retained for API compatibility; both insert a newer version
- Reads select the newest version per forecast key by max(updated_at); the latest write wins
- No Athena or Iceberg write is performed

Author:
- If author.type=ai, author.name MUST be provided

Sales amount:
- sales_amount is required and should equal units_sold * unit_price

Data type:
- data_type=forecast writes dataset=manual and preserves scenario_uuid
- data_type=actual forces dataset=actual and scenario_uuid=actual

company_id.description: Company id the write applies to. Must be authorized.

author.description: Who/what is making this change (for audit). If type='ai', name MUST be provided (ask the user for their name or team).

name.description: Display name or agent name. Required when type='ai'.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the actor (user id / agent id).

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the adjustment (stored for audit). Be specific (minimum 10 characters).

dry_run.description: If true, validate and preview writes without persisting.

write_mode.description: Compatibility mode. Both append and replace insert a newer ClickHouse version; queries using FINAL select the newest updated_at version for the forecast key.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate writes on retries.

debug_sql.description: Deprecated compatibility input; ClickHouse validation does not expose rendered SQL.

data_type.description: Type of data being written. 'forecast' (default) writes manual forecast adjustments (dataset='manual'). 'actual' writes sales history/actuals data — forces dataset='actual' and scenario_uuid='actual' regardless of per-write scenario_uuid values. Use 'actual' when importing historical sales data.

writes.description: One or more forecast write operations (period-level).

sku.description: Alternative item selector when inventory_id is not available.

marketplace.description: Marketplace for SKU-based writes (e.g., US/UK or amazon marketplace id). Also used to derive country_code.

sales_channel.description: Sales channel name. Defaults to 'Amazon' for Amazon marketplace forecasts. Use 'Amazon' unless writing non-Amazon channel data.

scenario_uuid.description: REQUIRED. Scenario identifier (slug). Stored in scenario_uuid and treated as the scenario name. Lowercase letters/numbers plus '-' or '_', 1–64 chars.

forecast_period.description: Forecast period key in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2026-01).

units_sold.description: Adjusted forecast units for the period.

sales_amount.description: Required adjusted revenue for the period. Derive as units_sold * unit_price.

currency.description: Required currency code for sales_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

note.description: Optional per-write note (e.g., promo, stockout, seasonality adjustment).

accepted.description: Count of writes accepted for processing.

written.description: Count of rows actually written (0 in dry-run).
